PRJ-DEC-0001.content: Iteration 1 is **T-shaped**: broad at the requirements/system level, then end-to-end for **one joint**.
PRJ-DEC-0001.title: Iteration 1 is T-shaped

PRJ-DEC-0002.content: One-joint E2E target: design artifacts plus **Zephyr firmware that builds and runs on a real STM32G4 board**, with the verification evidence traced back to requirements.
PRJ-DEC-0002.title: One-joint end-to-end target on a real STM32G4 board

PRJ-DEC-0003.content: Available hardware: NUCLEO-G4 board, PCA9685 breakout, MCP3208 breakout, SG90 servos, potentiometers.
PRJ-DEC-0003.title: Available hardware

PRJ-DEC-0005.content: The leader and follower **can be the same size**.
PRJ-DEC-0005.title: Leader and follower can be the same size

PRJ-DEC-0006.content: The number of PCBAs is **left to the SE work** (trade study in Phase 6).
PRJ-DEC-0006.title: The number of PCBAs is left to the SE work

PRJ-DEC-0007.content: Repos live in the existing **tiacsys** GitHub org and are **public from day one**. CI can check out other repos without extra tokens.
PRJ-DEC-0007.title: Public repos in the tiacsys GitHub org

PRJ-DEC-0008.content: **Zephyr:** for now, every role checks out the full Zephyr tree, including roles that only build docs. A smaller doc-only subset may come later.
PRJ-DEC-0008.title: Every role checks out the full Zephyr tree

PRJ-DEC-0009.content: robarm-manifest pins **xdmod by SHA** for now. Once xdmod has a stable release for other workspaces, it gets SemVer tags.
PRJ-DEC-0009.title: robarm-manifest pins xdmod by SHA

PRJ-DEC-0010.content: **robarm-sw CI builds the firmware** with the Zephyr SDK, runs the devicetree-vs-model check (``CK-F2``, a command in robarm-sw's ``checks.yaml``), and runs unit tests on ``native_sim``. This is not CAD, so :need:`XD-ADR-0049` doesn't exclude it.
PRJ-DEC-0010.title: robarm-sw CI builds the firmware

PRJ-DEC-0012.content: **Phase 4 GitHub action list approved** (:need:`XD-ADR-0112`): create the 7 public repos (``xdmod``, ``robarm-manifest``, ``robarm-syseng``, ``robarm-ee``, ``robarm-me``, ``robarm-sw``, ``robarm-integration``); settings (rebase merge only, delete branch on merge, Issues and Projects on, Wiki off); org ruleset ``xdmod-main`` (PR required with no approval count, up-to-date branches, linear history, no force push or deletion, admin bypass; required checks added once CI exists); labels; issues in project "xd-mod" (#3); Pages on robarm-manifest. Phase 4 runs autonomously within this list.
PRJ-DEC-0012.title: Phase 4 GitHub action list

PRJ-DEC-0013.content: **Licence: Apache-2.0 for all repos** (code, models, CAD, docs).
PRJ-DEC-0013.title: Licence: Apache-2.0 for all repos

PRJ-DEC-0014.content: **Zephyr SDK 1.0.1, ARM toolchain only**, installed into ``.venv/opt/zephyr-sdk`` and recorded in robarm-sw's ``tools.yaml`` with sha256.
PRJ-DEC-0014.title: Zephyr SDK 1.0.1, ARM toolchain only

PRJ-DEC-0015.content: **Workspace root before ``west init``:** ``spike/``, ``zdocs-tests/`` and ``.venv-zdocs/`` move to ``archive/``. The ``zdocs/`` clone becomes the west project ``tools/zdocs``, pinned to the PR branches (task 4.3a). ``extra/`` and ``build/`` stay. Nothing is deleted.
PRJ-DEC-0015.title: The workspace root before west init

PRJ-DEC-0016.content: **Phase 4 merge rights:** initial skeletons go straight to ``main`` of the new repos before the ruleset is switched on. After that, all Phase 4 work goes through PRs, and the coordinator agent may merge them in xdmod and robarm-* once CI is green and the agent review has no blocking findings. The owner gets a summary of each merge. This is a Phase 4 exception to :need:`XD-ADR-0044` and :need:`XD-ADR-0051`.
PRJ-DEC-0016.title: Phase 4 merge rights

PRJ-DEC-0017.content: **Rulesets are per repo, not per org.** Org rulesets need the GitHub Team plan. Each of the 7 repos has the same ``xdmod-main`` ruleset on its default branch: PR required (0 approvals, rebase only), linear history, no force push, no deletion. The admin role may bypass **only through a PR** (no direct pushes to ``main``). Required status checks and "branches up to date" (:need:`XD-ADR-0122`) are added in task 4.4, once each repo's CI check names exist. Refines :need:`PRJ-DEC-0012`.
PRJ-DEC-0017.title: Rulesets per repo

PRJ-DEC-0018.content: **Required checks (task 4.4):** in each repo's ``xdmod-main`` ruleset, required status checks with "branches up to date" (:need:`XD-ADR-0122`) from the GitHub Actions app: xdmod ``tests`` + ``check / check``; robarm-syseng, -ee, -me, -sw, -integration ``check / check``; robarm-manifest ``full-set`` (check run on normal PRs, commit status on bump PRs). CI installs the pinned Doxygen 1.18.0 from the release tarball, because Ubuntu's 1.9.8 breaks ``sw-api``.
PRJ-DEC-0018.title: Required status checks

arch.description: Mapping of uml key to uml content.

case_file.description: Path of the test's source file

case_line.description: Line of the test in its source file, counted from 1 where the report's base is known; for a pytest test, its first decorator's line, or its def's

case_name.description: Test case name without its parameter

case_parameter.description: Parameter of a parameterised test case ('a-b' for pytest's test_x[a-b]; Google Test's value_param, its type_param, or both as 'int, 42')

catalog.description: ME-PART from CAD: `<Manufacturer> <MPN>` of a bought part (FreeCAD properties `Manufacturer` and `MPN`, both set). A catalog part: R3 does not apply.

category.description: SYS-NEED: problem | objective | need. Requirements: functional | performance | interface | constraint.

check_id.description: XD-CHECK: the check's ID in curatrix (CK-...), as used by `curatrix check --only`.

config.description: The single SYS-CFG a test run was made on.

configs.description: SYS-CFG IDs the element belongs to; empty = all (D103).

constraints.description: List of constraint names, which are defined for this need.

constraints_error.description: An error message set if any constraint failed, and `error_message` field is set in config.

constraints_passed.description: True if all constraints passed, False if any failed, None if not yet checked.

constraints_results.description: Mapping of constraint name, to check name, to result, None if not yet checked.

content.description: The main content of the need.

date.description: XD-ADR / PRJ-DEC: the day the decision was made (YYYY-MM-DD).

decision_status.description: XD-ADR / PRJ-DEC: proposed (written, waiting for a spike or the owner) | accepted | revised (a newer decision changed part of it) | superseded (a newer decision replaced it). The newer decision holds the link.

derived.description: Domain requirement without an upstream link (needs a rationale).

docname.description: Name of the document where the need is defined (None if external).

doctype.description: The markup type of the content, denoted by the suffix of the source file, e.g. '.rst'.

ears.description: EARS pattern of the sentence (D12, D45).

external_css.description: CSS class name, added to the external reference.

external_url.description: URL of the need, if it is an external need.

has_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list.

has_forbidden_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list, and the link type does not allow dead links.

instances.description: Usages of a definition need (D128), e.g. leader.joint1.

is_external.description: If true, no node is created and need is referencing external url.

is_import.description: If true, the need was derived from an import.

is_modified.description: Whether the need was modified by needextend.

jinja_content.description: Whether the content was pre-processed by jinja.

layer.description: SYS-EL only: context | functional | logical | product.

layout.description: Key of the layout, which is used to render the need.

legacy_id.description: The old name of a decision or rule before it became a need, e.g. D37 or R3 (D120).

lineno.description: Line number where the need is defined (None if external).

parts.description: Mapping of parts, a.k.a. sub-needs, IDs to data that overrides the need's data

post_template.description: The template key, if the post_content was created from a jinja template.

pre_template.description: The template key, if the pre_content was created from a jinja template.

qualified_name.description: SysML qualified name of the element (generated needs).

remote_url.description: URL of the test's source in the remote repository

result.description: Test result status: passed, failed, error, skipped, disabled

result_text.description: One-line rendering of the first failure message

run_id.description: The run record a test result comes from (<UTC time>-<8 hex>); orders results by time.

shas.description: Pinned repo SHAs of the run: repo=sha entries (R5).

signature.description: Derived from a docutils desc_name node.

source_file.description: Generated needs: source path relative to the repo.

standard.description: ME-PART from CAD: the standard designation of a standard fastener (FreeCAD property `Standard`, e.g. `ISO 7380-1 M3x6, A2`). A catalog part: R3 does not apply.

status.description: draft | valid | retired (D64e, D130). draft: structure checks only, no coverage.

style.description: Comma-separated list of CSS classes (all appended by `needs_style_`).

sysml_kind.description: SysML metaclass of the element (generated needs).

template.description: The template key, if the content was created from a jinja template.

verification_scope.description: logical: evidence from any configuration counts; config: per configuration (D104).
